Infection Screening

STI / STD Screening & Treatment Guidance

Private consultation for possible sexually transmitted infections, including symptoms such as discharge, sores, burning, pain, or exposure concerns. The clinic can coordinate appropriate testing, explain results, and guide treatment or referral when needed.

Detailed Guidance

Private STI / STD symptom review

Symptoms such as discharge, genital ulcers or sores, blisters, burning urination, pain after intercourse, or partner-exposure concerns should be discussed early. Testing helps avoid guessing and protects both partners.

DischargeGenital ulcers or soresBurning urinationPain after intercoursePartner-exposure concerns

Testing and treatment guidance

The clinic can coordinate lab testing for suspected chlamydia, gonorrhoea, genital herpes, syphilis, and related infections, then explain reports and guide treatment planning or referral when needed.

ChlamydiaGonorrhoeaGenital herpesSyphilisPartner counseling
